# spaceman token

API tokens: list, create and revoke.

Aliases: `tokens`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman token create`](#spaceman-token-create) | Create an API token for yourself; the secret is shown once |
| [`spaceman token list`](#spaceman-token-list) | Your API tokens (--all-users: everyone's) |
| [`spaceman token revoke`](#spaceman-token-revoke) | Revoke one of your API tokens (--any: anyone's) |

## spaceman token create

Create an API token for yourself; the secret is shown once.

The token acts for you with the given grants, each within your own; it loses anything you lose. The root token cannot create API tokens (it is not a user).

```sh
spaceman token create <name> [flags]
```

API: `create-api-token` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman token create terraform --grant admin --expires-in-days 90 --secret-file ~/.config/spaceman/terraform.token
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--expires-in-days` | integer |  | expiry in days, 1-366 (required unless --never-expires) |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--grant` | string, repeatable |  | grant ROLE[:SPACE] (viewer, operator or admin; SPACE an ID or slug, default * = every space and global administration) (required) (repeatable or comma-separated) |
| `--idempotency-key` | string |  | Idempotency-Key to send (default: a fresh random key); reuse it to retry this create safely |
| `--never-expires` | bool |  | no expiry |
| `--secret-file` | string |  | write the one-time secret to this new file (mode 0600) instead of printing it |

## spaceman token list

Your API tokens (--all-users: everyone's).

```sh
spaceman token list [flags]
```

Aliases: `ls`.

API: `list-my-tokens`, `list-all-tokens` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--all-users` | bool |  | every user's tokens (needs token administration) |

## spaceman token revoke

Revoke one of your API tokens (--any: anyone's).

```sh
spaceman token revoke <token> [flags]
```

API: `revoke-my-token`, `revoke-any-token` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--any` | bool |  | revoke another user's token (needs token administration) |
